rendered: Production build served on port 3111. Public home at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 px: no horizontal overflow, mark 46 x 44 px, brand link 44 px tall. Public header rows: 320 and 360 px wrap to two rows as before (89 px); 390 and 430 px stay on one row (72 px) thanks to the 14 px wordmark rule at 430 px and below.

Real team header from the operator fixture (tests/operator/team-today-fixture.ts, real stylesheets): at 390 px its content is 342 px for 342 px of room; with the 46 px mark the row wrapped (header 61 px to 113 px, page 2.0308 screens). With the old 30 px mark and 8 px gap, and with the new 44 x 42 px mark and 4 px gap, header height is identical at 320 (165), 340, 360 and 375 (113), and 390, 414, 430, 500, 700 and 759 px (61). The earlier injected-markup check (three buttons) had missed this because its tool row was shorter than the real one; the fixture measurement supersedes it.

Wide layouts from injected markup (indicative only): header 64 px at 1280 expanded, collapsed rail and team, identical with the old 30 and 24 px mark; footer wordmark reversed on navy at 1440 px legible.
Favicon files rendered at 3x: favicon-16 orb tile, favicon-32, -48 and -64 halftone tile.

changedArtwork.icon.svg: halftone mark reversed on the navy tile, 0.92 of the tile, 21812 bytes; dot group equals the reversed mark's (test pins it)
changedArtwork.favicon.ico: 16 px entry unchanged (orb); 32 and 48 px entries rasterised from icon.svg
changedArtwork.docs/brand/assets/favicon: favicon.svg, favicon-32, -48, -64 and favicon.ico replaced; favicon-16 unchanged; apple, android and maskable files were already the halftone mark and are unchanged
changedArtwork.public/brand mark files: corridra-mark-cobalt.svg and -reversed.svg are byte-identical to docs/brand/assets/svg (test pins it)

notDone: No real signed-in session was rendered. The signed-in headers were measured through the operator fixtures for team Today and team navigation, and through injected markup for the rest. The customer shell was not rendered in a fixture here; the other operator shards passed on the first head and only gap and mark size changed since, in the direction that matches the old widths.
Open Graph and Twitter images already use the halftone lockup (checked by eye); not regenerated.
Browsers that prefer icon.svg show the halftone at 16 CSS px; only favicon.ico keeps the orb at 16 px.
Trademark check, vector master and legal handoff, tagline review and the art-direction review of the orb as a standalone mark stay open.
